findings.summary: addressed — Requester can replace all identifiers/source of a Draft via plain save, bypassing log_request's identifier-on-source check; refresh_matches then runs discovery for a stranger's email (probe confirmed). Lock these fields to the set_identifiers seam and re-check at submit/refresh.

addressed — approve's hold re-check uses pre-replan stored matches; an open deal found only by re-discovery is approved, then the job errors and the request stays Approved instead of On Hold. Check blocking_open_deals on the replanned rows.
addressed — REST doc read returns the full matches table (incl. records the caller cannot read) to requester and Sales Manager, bypassing preview's readability filter. Put matches at permlevel 1.
addressed — Pending disk-file list only in Redis (allkeys-lru); eviction or restart leaves PII-named files on disk with no DB pointer. Persist durably without PII.
addressed — System Manager can delete erasure requests: destroys the audit record of executed erasures and creates Deleted Document copies holding identifiers. Add an on_trash guard.
addressed — Rejected requests keep full identifiers and subject name indefinitely; retention runs only on Close.
addressed — Approved request whose job died without last_error polls forever with no Retry; show Retry after JOB_TIMEOUT.
addressed — Preview payload omits identifiers_not_on_subject (also crm/api/erasure.py docstring).
addressed — Due dates recomputed on every save with the current holiday list; deadlines of open requests drift silently.
addressed — follow_rename runs UPDATEs on every rename without a table-missing guard.
addressed — Roles snapshot can hide Erasure nav item before roles load.

addressed — Worker death between the Executed commit and _after_commit leaves outcome.pending_files non-empty with no last_error, so nothing prompts an operator to run finish_files. Set a pending-files last_error hint in the Executed transaction when pending_files is non-empty and clear it once deleted.

addressed — outcome.pending_files holds unsalted sha256 of predictable site paths (file names may spell her email) at permlevel 0; a requester or Sales Manager can confirm a guessed name. Salt with request name plus site secret, or keep the hashes at permlevel 1.

The pending-files hint is shown as a red 'Last error:' box on an Executed request, with a bench command visible to every viewer. Not harmful (Retry and polling stay Approved-only) but misleading; show a neutral 'cleanup pending' label for Executed/Closed or hide the command from non-officers.
